name: 1980s neon
places: US consumer and media design broadly
reacts_against: the earthy, muted 1970s palette, embracing synthetic brightness enabled by new fluorescent and early LED/LCD technology.
revivals: directly revived by synthwave and vaporwave from the early 2010s on
